objective_for_doctor: A 27-year-old F patient presents to the clinic. Chief complaint: skin lesions.

Doctor: Also, do the lesions burn/tingle or itch, and have you noticed any blisters, fluid, or crusting?

Doctor: If you can, please tell me whether you’ve had any urinary symptoms (burning, frequency) or any recent new medications, and how long ago the abdominal pain began.

Doctor: Also, when did the right iliac fossa pain start relative to the rash—before, after, or the same time?

Doctor: While I examine, do you have any fever, and can you estimate when the rash first became noticeable (today, days, or weeks)?
